parsedContent.feedback: The student correctly calculated the payback period, net present value, and profitability index for both projects, earning marks for these figures. The written explanation also provided a clear justification for choosing Project B, although some minor errors were present in the calculations. Own-figure marks were awarded for the later calculations that correctly followed from the initial values.
parsedContent.creditedBeyondCellMatch: Credit was given for the profitability index calculations and written explanation, which were not part of the strict cell-by-cell comparison.
